# Copilot instructions for roslyn-tools

This repository's canonical agent guide is **`AGENTS.md`** at the repository
root. Read it before making changes — it covers build/test/lint commands,
architecture (Core service + thin host adapters pattern), and coding
conventions specific to this codebase.

@AGENTS.md

See also, linked from `AGENTS.md`:

- `docs/architecture-overview.md` — layered architecture, contracts, output
  pipeline, safety net.
- `docs/pattern-core-service.md` — worked examples of the Core-service pattern.
- `docs/agent-playbook.md` — detailed agent operating guidance.
- `docs/adr/` — Architecture Decision Records.
